name: KYUDEN Holdings Inc.
summary: KYUDEN Holdings Inc. engages in the power generation, transmission, distribution, and retail in Japan and internationally. It is also involved in construction and maintenance of electrical equipment; sale of gas / LNG and coal; renewable energy business; data communication; optical broadband; telecommunications construction and maintenance; information system development; public-private partnership, and data center business. Further, the company develops and manages real estate. KYUDEN Holdings Inc. was founded in 1951 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan.
